notes.title: Update 3.6!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

This update will add indication of who is talking throughout the game, as well as clean up some more typos that I noticed while doing so.

I did my best to push this through last night but couldn't stay up all night soo, you get it now. 

If you notice any where the text isn't working properly please feel free to either message me or write in the Bugs Discussion, and I'll get back to it after work!

Also I am doing what I can to fix the Achievement problem, so hopefully I will be able to get back to you with another update soon that will fix it.

Thanks for your time and have fun out there!
ːPredatorTheCatː

notes.title: Update 3.3 Is live!! Achievements!
notes.notes:
For a list of Achievements please view: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/1166BT#announcements/detail/240217512922358721

Here are the update notes!
Stability of movement speeds

New art for city sky

Cannot attack in Cop station

Fixed level back loops

Player attacked cleaned up

Various typos

Moms room trigger too large

Dream 2 monsters not facing Alex

Alex Dream 2: moved monsters hit box down to keep them more in hit zone

Can’t talk to Large Monster in Alex dream. Portal location fixed

Panning too fast in after dream Alex's Dream#2

Marble table better hitbox

Fixed barriers in various scenes

As well as some other small things that weren't worth mentioning


Beta will be over in 7 weeks so look forward to the upcoming release!
Thanks for your interest and support!

notes.title: Incoming Achievements! (Update 3.3)
notes.notes:
Hey there everybody!

The Achievements Bug has been fixed, which means that the next update will have a set of 23 Achievements (along with many other specific tweaks to the overall game. More info when the update is live.) . Pressing Tab will open the Achievement interface at any point in the game. 

Here is a list of the different Achievements that will be available!

 
First Step","The Longest Journey Starts With a Single Step."  

Sympathizer","Talk to a monster...They can't be that bad, right?"  	

Poor Alex","See Alex at her worst."  	

Poor, Poor Alex","See Alex at her worst, twice."  	

Cat Whisperer","Talk to a cat you didn't have to talk to."  	

The Hostel","Defeat the Great Beast in the Hostel Halls. Did you run or did you fight?"  	

Dream Walker","Defeat the Beast that lives in your Dreams. Did you run or fight?"  	

Hell Spawn","Defeat the Beast that stirs in the depths. Did you run or fight?"  	

Smoke and Ash","Discover the Good Ending.  	

Last Rites","Discover the Bad Ending.

Five More Minutes","Discover a Passive Ending.  	

The Sad Truth","Discover the all of the endings."   	

The Elder","Follow the Candle."   	

The Beast","Follow the Cane."  	

The Sacrifice","Follow the Blade."  	

The Abused","Follow the Phone."  	

The Butterfly", "Follow the Cuff."  	

The Punished","Follow the Car." 	

The Fool","Put ??? to Sleep."  	

The Playground","Put Marchosias to Sleep."  	

The Failure","Put Lucas to Sleep."  	

The Tortured","Put Alex to Sleep."  	

The Justifier","Put Amy to Sleep."  	

The Wrathful","Put Daudaz to Sleep." 

I hope to see you all in game soon!
Have a good day!
